messages:
Aisha Patel: Heads-up — we're seeing an increase in 5xx errors from the embeddings endpoint starting ~08:12 UTC. ~12 customers impacted, mostly batch requests >2k tokens and a few cache-miss paths. Incident INC-5631 created. Jamal + eng on it. I want to align on customer comms and who we reach out to high-touch. :warning:

IncidentBot: Incident INC-5631 created: Embeddings service 5xx spike — severity: high. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-5631

Jamal Shah (SRE): Root cause looks like a race in the prefix KV-cache eviction after the recent batching optimization rollout. Under high concurrency some in-memory pointers were invalidated while requests still referencing them -> 5xx. Reproduced in staging with synthetic concurrent batch loads.

Jamal Shah (SRE): Immediate mitigation: rolled back batching optimization on serving-pool-4 (hotfix v2.14.3 rollback), increased KV cache TTL, added guard in code to return 429 instead of 500 on detected invalidation while we patch. Metrics showing error rate drop. ETA for monitoring confirmation ~25m.

Marco Ruiz: Thanks. Can you put together a customer-safe summary (2-3 lines) and a recommended compensation offer? Also need a list of affected accounts that are near renewal / on enterprise plans — want to prioritize outreach.

Aisha Patel: Draft customer message (please copy/edit):
"Hi <CustomerName>,

We want to let you know we experienced elevated 5xx errors on our embeddings endpoint earlier today between ~08:12–08:45 UTC due to an internal caching race after a recent optimization rollout. We’ve rolled back the change and implemented mitigations; error rates are back near baseline and we continue to monitor. We’re investigating the root cause and will share a full RCA by EOD. We sincerely apologize for any disruption — we’re offering a 10% invoice credit for impacted usage and can schedule a 1:1 to review your usage patterns and mitigation options.

If you’d like immediate support, reply here or schedule time with your CS lead"

Aisha Patel: High-touch list: I pulled logs and flagged these accounts (private list in GA): EllipseCorp, VeloTrade, FundBright, AtlasML. Marco — please confirm and send the high-touch template. For lower-touch customers, a concise status + ticket is fine.

Nora Kim: Suggest we tag these accounts in HubSpot as "INC-5631-affected" and trigger the renewal playbook if they have renewals <90d. Also add a short line in the onboarding queue for any customers in ramp who rely on embeddings heavily.

Jamal Shah (SRE): Update: rollback completed on serving-pool-4 at 08:34 UTC. Error rate dropped from ~6.8% to ~0.5% in the last 10m (baseline ~0.2%). Still watching; reduced traffic to pool while we confirm fix. Next steps: ship a patch that adds eviction guards + stronger canary checks, then re-enable optimized batching behind stricter canary policy.

Marco Ruiz: Got it. I'll send the high-touch template to EllipseCorp, VeloTrade, and FundBright within 30m. Proposed compensation: 10% credit + offer 1:1 technical review. Will ping here when messages are sent.

Aisha Patel: Perfect. Please use the template above, personalize one sentence per account. Tag me and @Nora when done. Also flag any customers who express churn/renewal concerns — we'll escalate to AE.

IncidentBot: INC-5631 status update: mitigated -> monitoring. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-5631/updates

Jamal Shah (SRE): Follow-up: we'll open a PR with the eviction check and a unit test that simulates concurrent invalidation. Plan to release a patch and perform a small canary (1% traffic) before broader rollout. RCA doc will include timeline and follow-up action items.

Marco Ruiz: Messages sent to EllipseCorp and VeloTrade. EllipseCorp asked for SSO token validation during the incident window — they requested logs. I shared temporary logs and scheduled a 30m call for 09:15 UTC. VeloTrade asked to confirm whether cached prefixes were lost for long-running jobs; I offered the 1:1.

Aisha Patel: Thanks Marco. Add notes to the account records and set renewal risk flag if they push hard. I'll draft the RCA summary for CS to use in customer followups, aim to post in #customer-success by EOD.

IncidentBot: INC-5631 updated: monitoring -> resolved at 09:40 UTC. Full RCA pending.

Aisha Patel: Closing note — please escalate any customer asks about credits/contract terms to me before committing. Good job team, will follow up with the RCA and recommended playbook changes. :white_check_mark:
